name: p2-fail-on-error-topology

base_results.finding: item219 topology replay underdelivered because validator-1 endpoints were slow
validator-1 writer overprovision did not restore p1 delivery
excluding validator-1 raised per-endpoint p1 target too high and regressed throughput

purpose: Recover green live throughput by testing the known 12-endpoint topology with pipeline depth 2 while preserving fail-fast request-error semantics and Mahi state-root correctness checks.

planned_benchmark.command: LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-248-p2-fail-on-error-100k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=2 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 100000 60

result.decision: Binned. Pipeline depth 2 completed with zero request errors and correct state roots, but it lowered delivered load and committed TPS versus the p1 references. It is not a green recovery path.

notes: This is a canary, not a relaxed green run. Pipelined writers disable strict nonce retry because strict retry is p1-only, so fail-on-errors is mandatory.
If any endpoint reports nonce_err, rpc_err, or net_err, the run is binned regardless of committed TPS and the cluster must be wiped before the next attempt.
